Maya (Finance): Quick question for close  Reseller CloudForge paid an annual bundle (RF-ANNUAL-2026) on 2026-03-05. They asked us to split March revenue to match end-customer consumption for internal reports. How should we treat deferrals/allocations for 03/31?

Ethan (Billing): We booked the cash to Unearned Revenue on receipt. We dont currently allocate at the GL level to underlying end-customers. We can produce an allocation CSV (pro rata by usage) for internal analytics.

Sam (Accounting): For external close: keep JEs at reseller level. JE on receipt: Dr Cash 1010 / Cr Unearned Rev 2205. Recognize earned portion for March as usual. If Finance wants an internal split, RevOps can provide allocation file but that does not change GAAP JEs unless contract says we act as agent.

Maya (Finance): Got it. We need: 1) Billing CSV mapping reseller invoice to end-customer usage through 03/31; 2) one-paragraph memo for the close pack stating principal vs agent assessment.

Ethan (Billing): Will upload allocation CSV to #finance-uploads in ~60m. Format: reseller_inv, receipt_date, total_prepaid, end_customer_id, usage_units_thru_0331, allocated_amount.

RevOpsBot: Note: Marked invoice RF-ANNUAL-2026 as "reseller-bundle" in scheduler. Internal allocation file will be flagged internal-only.

Sam (Accounting): If contract indicates agent treatment, we need the contract excerpt. Otherwise proceed with gross recognition and include the internal allocation as supporting analytics only. Add the clause to the close pack for auditors.

Maya (Finance): Thanks  once CSV and contract excerpt (if any) are in, I'll draft the memo and JE lines for review. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
